title: Haaye Kamar Todh Gaye Bhai Hume Chodhe Gaye
body:
Haaye Kamar Todh Gaye Bhai Hume Chodhe Gaye
Sogaye Kudh Naher Par Rota Hume Chodh Gaye
1.Kis Ke Sahare Jeeye Ashk Kahan Tak Peeye
Chak Jigar Hogaya Kaise Gijar Ku Seeye
Mout Ka Saman Hai Lab Pe Meri Jaan Hai Aaiye Baba Ali
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Bole Imam-e-Zaman Dard Se Dil Hai Tapa
Tu Hi Baata Alkhama Bhai Mera Hai Kahan
Hogaya Kaise Ghazab Paou Kahan Usku Ab Aaiye Maa Fatima
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Mash-o –Alam Aagaye Ap Kahan Rehgaye
Tukdhe Jigar Ke Mere Ashkou Me Sab Bhegaye
Dil Ke Bhot Pass They Wo Tu Meri Aas Hai They Aaiye Bhai Hasan
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Wo Toh Alamdar They Kitne Wafadar They
Wo Toh Meri Fouj Ke Syed-o-Sardar They
Jaan-e-Sipah-e-Khuda Khugaya Bhai Mera Jaagiye Zain-Ul-Aba
